verified_findings.title: Dead-code CustomEvent dispatch — zero listeners, harmless (NOT a dead button)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: grep -rn 'foodking:pos:open-encaissement' resources/js/ → only 2 matches, both in this file: L912 (comment) and L924 (the dispatch). grep for addEventListener('...open-encaissement') across resources/js → ZERO matches. The dispatched event has no listener anywhere in the app, confirming dead code. CONTEXT VERIFIED: the Encaisser button itself WORKS — L227 @click=openEncaissement(order) → L921 this.encaisseOrder = {...order, total: amount} → modal rendered at L401-404 (PosCounterCollectModal :order=encaisseOrder @confirmed=onEncaisseConfirmed @cancel=encaisseOrder=null), component registered L438, data init L471. The L924 dispatch is wrapped in try/catch and fires AFTER the modal already opened on L921, so it causes no user-visible breakage.
verified_findings.recommendation: Remove the L922-927 CustomEvent dispatch and its comment block (L922). It is leftover from the pre-fix decoupled design and now adds only confusion — a future maintainer may believe a global host still listens. No behavior change: the modal path at L921 is the sole live wiring. Pure cleanup, optional.

summary: Verified the single raw P3 finding against HEAD 04603fa87. CONFIRMED TRUE. The 'foodking:pos:open-encaissement' CustomEvent dispatch at L924 has zero listeners across all of resources/js (re-grepped: only the dispatch L924 + comment L912 match; no addEventListener). It is harmless dead code, NOT a dead button — the Encaisser CTA is fully wired: openEncaissement (L909) sets encaisseOrder (L921) which renders PosCounterCollectModal (L401-404, all three events wired, component registered L438). 0 findings dropped, 1 confirmed. No false positives in the raw set. The surface is essentially clean; only this P3 cleanup note stands.
